newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT-Scitex up after Lehman comment.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT-Scitex up after Lehman comment.

text.p: Scitex Corp Ltd on Monday rallied after positive remarks by Lehman Brothers, amid generally quiet trading in American Depositary Receipts ahead of Tuesday's Federal Reserve policy meeting.
At midsession, Scitex's Nasdaq-listed shares were up 7/8 to 9-3/8, a gain of over 10 percent, in active trade.
Earlier, Lehman said it expected the Israeli maker of computer-imaging systems used in printing and publishing to post a smaller 1997 loss than the securities firm had been previously forecast.
